newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi man beheaded for shooting.
newsitem.headline: Saudi man beheaded for shooting.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Saudi man for fatally shooting another Saudi after an argument, Saudi state-run television said.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the television gave no further details.
The beheading in the Saudi capital Riyadh was the sixth execution in the kingdom this year.
The conservative kingdom enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals.
